description: This file implements the NetworkErrorLoggingService class, which manages network error logging policies, reports, and interactions with persistent storage and reporting services within the Chromium project. It includes methods for handling headers, requests, signing exchange reports, and policy management, along with internal classes and data structures for policies and error handling.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the NetworkErrorLoggingService interface, managing policies, error reporting, and interactions with storage and reporting services.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::NelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key structure combining NetworkAnonymizationKey and origin for identifying policies.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::WildcardNelPolicyKey
classes.description: Key structure for wildcard policies based on domain and network key.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::NelPolicy
classes.description: Represents a network error logging policy with parameters like report destination, expiration, and sampling fractions.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::RequestDetails
classes.description: Holds details of network requests for error reporting.

classes.name: NetworkErrorLoggingService::SignedExchangeReportDetails
classes.description: Holds details for signed exchange error reports.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Handles incoming NEL headers to set policies.

methods.name: OnRequest
methods.description: Processes network request details for error reporting.

methods.name: QueueSignedExchangeReport
methods.description: Queues a signed exchange error report.

methods.name: StatusAsValue
methods.description: Returns the current status of policies as a JSON value.

methods.name: GetPolicyKeysForTesting
methods.description: Returns current policy keys for testing.

methods.name: GetPersistentNelStoreForTesting
methods.description: Returns the persistent store for testing.

methods.name: GetReportingServiceForTesting
methods.description: Returns the reporting service for testing.
